lifecycle_rules.creation: Draft authored locally in weddingStorage with syncStatus 'LOCAL_ONLY'
lifecycle_rules.auto_sync: useEvents attempts background sync with persistWeddingDraft upon backend list load
lifecycle_rules.sync_success: Backend returns server-owned ID; local record updated to 'SYNCED' and merged with backend list
lifecycle_rules.sync_failure: On network/template rejection, draft remains retained in localStorage with 'SYNC_FAILED' and error details; card displays 'Sync failed' badge and 'Resume draft'
lifecycle_rules.contextual_banner: EventsFeature displays top 'Continue where you left off' banner for pending LOCAL_ONLY or SYNC_FAILED drafts without active filters
lifecycle_rules.account_switch_isolation: Drafts indexed by ownerUserId; logging out or switching accounts wipes User A drafts from memory and prevents leaking to User B
